From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Latin prōnūntiātiōnem.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /pɾonunθjaˈθjon/ [pɾo.nũn̟.θjaˈθjõn] (Spain, Equatorial Guinea)
  • IPA(key): /pɾonunsjaˈsjon/ [pɾo.nũn.sjaˈsjõn] (Latin America, Philippines)
  • Audio (Colombia):(file)
  • Rhymes: -on
  • Syllabification: pro‧nun‧cia‧ción

Noun

[edit]

pronunciación f (plural pronunciaciones)

  1. pronunciation
  2. pronouncement

Related terms

[edit]
  • pronunciar

Further reading

[edit]
  • “pronunciación”, in Diccionario de la lengua española [Dictionary of the Spanish Language] (in Spanish), online version 23.8.1, Royal Spanish Academy [Spanish: Real Academia Española], 15 December 2025
